_note: Registration snippet — AUTHORING-BRIEF 'Registration protocol'. Content
agents do not touch content/manifest.js, content/manifest.json or
server/lib/rules.php; the integrator applies this and deletes the file.
ORDER MATTERS: r12 is the TWELFTH AND LAST region of the fabulae track
and must sit after r11 in the manifest's regions array — js/app.js
regionIndex() reads that order and feeds it to the phase engine as the
ONE difficulty input (DESIGN §6). Applied out of order, the FINALE plays
easier than Regiō XI. APPLY LAST, after the R7-R9 snippets (a parallel
author owns those), after r10 and after r11.
*** r12 IS THE ONLY FOUR-PHASE BOSS IN THE PRODUCT. ***
caterva 3/22 + clamor 3/26 + fuga 2/20 + clamor 2/22 = hp 10 over 90
phase-seconds. The repeated `clamor` type is deliberate and is supported:
js/boss.js buildPlan() iterates the phase list and does not deduplicate
types, and js/boss-phases.js prefers a phase's own `cfg.data.items` over
`boss.clamor`, so the two clamor phases carry different item sets — the
first this region's own S12 grammar, the second a cumulative syntax exam
over the whole track. Both paths were read in the engine source and the
region was rendered against the real art library before shipping.
*** bossMinMs 20000, NOT the 15000 every other duel region uses. ***
This is the one anti-cheat value in the track that MOVES. The fight is 90
phase-seconds over FOUR phases against r11's 80 over three, so a floor
tuned for a three-phase fight would be wrong here. If the integrator
applies a blanket 15000 across the fabulae regions, r12 must be exempted.
Legacy single-phase tuning in the content file is hp 10 / 65 s, kept
because rules.php reads it and because a client without
js/boss-phases.js must still be able to fight (same shape as r10's
hp 8 / 55 s and r11's hp 9 / 60 s).
quizKey carries the same three keys per row as r03-r06, r10 and r11:
rules.php stores {q, a}, and `correct` is always 0 against the boss.quiz
order in content/fabulae-r12.js. Every word is a vocabulary entry WITH a
picture in the capitulum named by `from`, which is what app.js
bossWords() needs.
NOTE FOR THE ENGINE BACKLOG, not for this integration: a finale wants a
TRACK-WIDE quiz and cannot have one. app.js bossWords() builds its pool
from CUR.region.capitula only, and runBossQuiz() silently DROPS an entry
it cannot resolve, so a row naming an earlier region's capitulum would
quietly shorten the quiz instead of failing. The cumulative feel is built
the legitimate way instead — r12's own cards deliberately carry words
first taught in R1, R2, R4, R6, R10 and R11. See
content/_ledger-fabulae-part2.md, 'THE BOSS' section, for the full note
and for the second backlog item (no post-win text hook, which is why
'Lupus līber discēdit.' could not ship).
r12 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases().
XP: the fight is worth MORE than an ordinary region's because it is the
finale and is half again as long — boss 40 against the 30 r05/r06/r10/r11
use. Quiz XP and the pass threshold are unchanged. The step XP is left to
RULE_DEFAULT_STEP_XP as in every earlier fabulae region. If the
integrator would rather keep every region identical, 30 is safe and
nothing else in this file depends on it.
